mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS sessionId, u.id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.display_name AS displayName FROM platform_admin_session s INNER JOIN platform_admin_user u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND s.status = 1 AND s.expire_at > NOW() AND u.status = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_admin_session SET status = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND status = 1
UPDATE platform_admin_session SET status = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
